•	 Meat may be seasoned with onion, garlic, green pepper, nut-

APPENDIX 30  Sodium in Food
•	 Cranberry sauce, applesauce, or jellies make appetizing 
accompaniments to meats and poultry.
•	 Vegetables can be flavored by the addition of onion, mint, 
ginger, mace, dill seed, parsley, green pepper, or fresh mush-
rooms.
